Schultz served as director of the Army National Guard until retiring in 2005. he was succeeded by Clyde A. Vaughn. After retiring from the military, Schultz was named Vice President of Unitech, a company which provided homeland security and military training and simulation products and services to government and the military. Unitech was later purchased by Lockheed Martin, and Schultz became a program Management Director.
